facts.fact_text: At the material time, the applicant was a member of the local branch of the trade union of Education and Science Workers (Eğitim ve Bilim Emekçileri Sendikası).
At the material time, the applicant was secretary of the local branch of the trade union of Education and Science Workers (Eğitim ve Bilim Emekçileri Sendikası).
On 28 November 2008, the applicant participated in a demonstration organised by the trade union of Education and Science Workers (Eğitim ve Bilim Emekçileri Sendikası).
The demonstration of 28 November 2008 was held on the theme 'No to violence against women'.
On 29 June 2009, the District Directorate of National Education imposed a disciplinary sanction on the applicant in the form of a reprimand.
The disciplinary sanction of reprimand imposed on the applicant on 29 June 2009 was imposed for her participation in the demonstration of 28 November 2008.
On 29 July 2009, the Disciplinary Board of the Yenişehir district governor dismissed the applicant's objection to the reprimand decision of 29 June 2009.
The Disciplinary Board of the Yenişehir district governor dismissed the applicant's objection on the ground that the contested decision was in accordance with law.
The Disciplinary Board of the Yenişehir district governor dismissed the applicant's objection on the ground that there were no grounds for the annulment of the contested decision.
The disciplinary sanction of reprimand imposed on the applicant on 29 June 2009 was imposed under Article 125 of Law no. 657 on Civil Servants.
